preconditions.description: Number of cities is between 1 and 5000.
Number of roads is between 0 and 5000.
Index of the capital is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two different cities within the range.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of new roads needed to make all cities reachable from the capital.
